text: In January of each year, a Notice of Appointment of Representative is received from the Royal Agricultural Winter Fair (RAWF) requesting the appointment of one representative of the Board to the RAWF. At its meeting of March 23, 2017, the Board appointed Connie Dejak to the RAWF for the 2016 and 2017 term: http://app.toronto.ca/tmmis/viewAgendaItemHistory.do?item=2017.EP2.16 Given that Connie Dejak has been a member of the Board since 2011 and was first appointed as representative of the Board to the RAWF for 2015 and 2016 term, I believe it is appropriate that she continue to represent Exhibition Place for 2018. The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Appointed Connie Dejak as the Board representative to the Royal Agricultural Winter Fair Association for the 2018 term.
